# WebMinor

> WebMinor is a web design consultancy based in Saltash, Cornwall, UK. We build fast, conversion-focused websites for local trades businesses across South West England.

## About

WebMinor was founded by Adam Butcher, a designer and developer with 25+ years of experience in graphic design and web development. We specialise in websites for plumbers, electricians, roofers, and builders.

## Services

- Web Design for Trades: Custom, mobile-first websites built for conversion
- Local SEO: Get found by local customers searching for your trade
- Google Business Profile Setup: Optimise your Google presence for local search
- Lead Generation & PPC: Paid advertising to drive qualified leads

## Pricing

- Starter: £49/month (£0 setup) — 3-page site, mobile-ready, hosting, SSL, basic SEO
- Growth: £99/month (£299 setup) — 5-page custom site, local SEO, Google Business Profile, monthly reporting
- Dominate: £199/month (£499 setup) — Full custom build, advanced SEO, PPC setup, content, priority support

## Coverage

We serve trades businesses across: Exeter, Plymouth, Bristol, Bath, Taunton, Truro, Torquay, Bournemouth, Poole, Gloucester, Swindon, Cheltenham
